name: AI Agents Usage
author: Murali-lns
description: A native Omarchy bar panel for local usage, limits, pace, and model statistics from Claude Code, Codex, Fireworks, Hermes, and Grok.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel for local usage, limits, pace, recent history, and model breakdowns.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, or another user-selected tool.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
